lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, line 22, column (ii), "enter the amount of the QPVLI, if any, that was deducted elsewhere on your return"; fr-2025-24154 p. 21, proposed § 1.163-16(d)(2)(iii)(A), "payments of interest and principal are allocated ... on a pro rata basis", and (d)(4) for a refinancing; p. 23, (g)(1), "Independently deductible interest is limited to interest that is QPVLI". The Schedule C interest is interest on the whole loan, so its QPVLI part is its pro rata share; the reply caps the whole Schedule C interest at the loan's QPVLI instead (triage: stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated, project $84.80, reply $106.00), and asks column (ii) without a Schedule C (candidate-unknown on returns the project gives zero). Same as the earlier rulings on this line.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, line 22, column (iii), "enter the total amount of the QPVLI paid or accrued on the loan during the taxable year minus the amount on line 22, column (ii)". The QPVLI is the same on both sides; every difference follows the reply's column (ii), ruled a model error (stage12.car.mixed_sc_interest_prorated: project $254.40, reply $233.20). Same as the earlier rulings on this line.
